text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: Boxy dark brown button-front work jacket with pointed collar, light gray Henley underlayer, extra-wide black trousers and black leather shoes. Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
